description: This file contains partial class definitions and extension methods related to Cassandra clustering configuration within the Orleans framework. It defines options for Cassandra clustering and provides extension methods to integrate Cassandra clustering into Orleans client and silo builders.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Cassandra clustering, including retry delay and TTL usage, with methods to configure the Cassandra client session.

classes.name: CassandraMembershipHostingExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to add Cassandra clustering support to Orleans client and silo builders.
